description: Search street-level crimes recorded in one month, or with month_from a range of up to 12 months, inside an area — a point with a 1-mile radius, a polygon, a snapped location_id from an earlier result, or a police neighbourhood — or list the crimes a force could not place on the map (area 'force_unplaced'). Returns the total, counts by category and by latest police outcome, the busiest map points, each month's total for a range, and a page of crimes, each with the persistent_id that ukcrime_get_crime_outcomes takes; for what police resolved in a month, whenever the crime was recorded, use ukcrime_search_outcomes. Locations are anonymised map points, not crime sites. data.police.uk can refuse an area holding more than about 10,000 crimes, whatever the category — then search smaller polygons.

area.description: Area to search: 'point' (lat and lng; a 1-mile radius), 'polygon' (polygon), 'location' (location_id), 'neighbourhood' (force and neighbourhood_id), or 'force_unplaced' (force alone: the crimes that force could not place on the map). An area field the chosen area does not use is rejected.

category.description: Crime category slug such as 'burglary', or its display name such as 'Violence and sexual offences'; case-insensitive, and spaces, underscores and hyphens match each other ('vehicle_crime' finds 'vehicle-crime'). Omitted: every category (all-crime). ukcrime_list_reference topic 'categories' lists them.

force.description: Force id such as 'leicestershire', or its name such as 'Leicestershire Police' (ukcrime_list_reference topic 'forces' lists both); case-insensitive, spaces, underscores and hyphens match each other, '&' matches 'and', and a trailing 'Police', 'Police Service' or 'Constabulary' is optional. For area 'neighbourhood' (with neighbourhood_id) and 'force_unplaced' (alone), where 'btp' (British Transport Police) is also accepted.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, for area 'point'.

lng.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, for area 'point'.

location_id.description: For area 'location': location.location_id from an earlier result — one anonymised map point.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM, or the last month of the range with month_from. Omitted: the latest published month, echoed as month in the result.

month_from.description: First month of a range, YYYY-MM, searched through month — up to 12 months, with a total for each in by_month. Omitted: month alone.

neighbourhood_id.description: For area 'neighbourhood', with force: a neighbourhood id from ukcrime_list_reference topic 'neighbourhoods', or from ukcrime_find_neighbourhood for a point. Case-sensitive; only trimmed.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page; pass next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

polygon.description: For area 'polygon': 3–2,500 vertices as { lat, lng } objects, or the string 'lat,lng:lat,lng:…'. The ring closes itself (the last vertex joins the first). [lng, lat] pairs are not accepted.

items.description: One polygon vertex as { lat, lng }.

name: ukcrime_search_crimes

area.description: The area as the server searched it.

force.description: Force id, when the area names one.

located_force.description: Force covering the point, or the location's map point, when located.

located_forces.description: For 'polygon': forces its bounding-box centre and outermost vertices were located in, sorted; a point whose lookup failed adds none. Absent when none was located.

located_neighbourhood.description: Neighbourhood covering the point, or the location's map point, when located.

by_category.description: Matched crimes by category slug, most first.

by_month.description: Crimes matched in each month of the range, oldest first; their totals sum to total. Present only when month_from was given.

total.description: Matched records in this month, after every filter.

by_outcome.description: Matched crimes by latest police outcome, most first; anti-social behaviour is always '(not recorded)'.

slug.description: Category slug searched; all-crime means every category.

crimes.description: This page of matched crimes: oldest month first over a range, then by category, then location_id, then id.

location.description: Absent for crimes the force could not place.

location_id.description: Map point id; pass it as location_id with area 'location'.

map_point.description: Anonymised point covering at least eight addresses, not where it happened. Absent when unpublished.

subtype.description: Station or premises type, when published.

type.description: 'BTP': a British Transport Police station record; 'Force': a territorial force's.

outcome.description: Latest police outcome. Absent when unpublished, always for anti-social behaviour.

persistent_id.description: Id ukcrime_get_crime_outcomes takes. Absent when unpublished, always for anti-social behaviour.

data_note.description: What these records can and cannot say; read it first.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_area`: the area's required fields are missing, or a field it does not use is present. `month_not_published`: month or month_from is after the latest published month. `month_out_of_range`: month or month_from is before the 36-month window. `invalid_month_range`: month_from is after month, or the range spans more than 12 months. `unknown_category`: category matches no category slug or name. `unknown_force`: force matches no listed force id or name, or more than one, or is 'btp' on area 'neighbourhood'. `unknown_neighbourhood`: the force has no neighbourhood with this id (ids are case-sensitive). `unknown_location`: data.police.uk holds no map point with this location_id. `area_too_large`: the area is too large to answer: data.police.uk can refuse one holding more than about 10,000 crimes. `range_too_large`: the range's months hold more records than one call keeps for a range. `range_incomplete`: the months of the range could not all be fetched within the time one call allows. `upstream_unavailable`: data.police.uk is not answering. `rate_limited`: data.police.uk is rate-limiting this server for longer than this call can wait. `pacer_shed`: too many requests to data.police.uk are already queued in this server. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: data.police.uk did not answer within the time one call allows. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

month.description: The month searched, or the last month of the range, YYYY-MM.

month_from.description: First month of the range searched, YYYY-MM; present only when month_from was given.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Defaulted month, coverage gaps, why a result is empty, and how to page on.

top_locations.description: Up to 10 map points holding the most matched crimes. Absent for area 'force_unplaced'.

items.description: One map point and its crime count.

map_point.description: Anonymised map point, not where crimes happened.

total.description: Crimes matched in the area over the month or range.

truncated.description: True when more rows remain after this page.

title: Search UK Street-Level Crimes
